tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gser 'od g.yang skyabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya su warṇa sarta nā ma ma hā ya na sū tra hu ye/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las g.yang skyabs zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod phung po'i ri'i rtse mo chos kyi dbyings kyi spyod yul na de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs so// de'i tshe nyan thos kyi dge slong gi dge 'dun 'bum phrag grangs med pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med grangs med pa dang*/ li tsā byi gzhon nu stong phrag lnga bcu brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ lha'i bu bzhi khri nyis stong dang*/ klu'i bu mo sum khri drug stong dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po bzhi khri dgu stong dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ ri dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ rgya mtsho dang chu'i lha la sogs pa thams cad bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/ sems rtse gcig tu byas shing thal mo sbyar nas mig mi 'dzum par bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la blta zhing gsol ba 'debs so// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dus pa mang po la thugs brtse ba'i spyan gyis gzigs nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to// mdo sde'i dbang po rgyal po ste// nyan na shin tu zab pa dang*// yongs su brtags na zab pa nyid// gser 'od dam pa 'di 'chad do// phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni// byin gyis brlabs te brjod par bya// mi 'khrugs pas ni shar phyogs su// rin chen tog gis lho phyogs su// 'od dpag med kyis nub phyogs su// rnga sgra yis ni byang phyogs su// sdig pa thams cad gzhig pa'i phyir// bshad pa dam pa bkra shis pa// sdig pa thams cad zad byed pa// sdug bsngal thams cad 'jig par byed// thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gzhi// dpal kun gyis ni legs par brgyan// byin gyis brlabs te brjod par bya// sems can gang dag dbang po nyams// tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams dang*// phun sum tshogs min gang chags dang*// lha rnams rgyab kyis phyogs pa dang*// mdza' sdug skye bo sdang ba dang*/

bran bza' la sogs gtses pa dang*// phan tshun mthun pa ma yin dang*// nor 'gribs pas ni gnod pa dang*// mya ngan ngal dang gnod pa dang*// 'jigs pa dang ni 'phongs pa dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar byad stems dang*/ mi bzad gdon gyis nyen pa dang*// mya ngan mngal las byung ba yi// rmi lam sdig pa mthong na yang*// de ni rab bkrus gtsang ma yis// mdo sde dam pa nyan par bya// gang dag yid dge sems dang zhing*// gos gtsang gis ni rab brgyan te// zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba// mdo sde 'di ni nyan byed na// mdo sde 'di yi gzi brjid kyis// shin tu mi zad 'di 'dra ba// de dag rab tu zhi bar 'gyur// 'jig rten skyong ba bdag nyid dang*// blon po'i tshogs kyi dbang phyug bcas// gnod sbyin bye ba du ma yis// de dag la ni bsrung bar byed// lha mo chen mo dbyangs can dang*/ na ra dza na gnas pa dang*// 'byung po'i ma mo 'phrog ma dang*// sa'i lha mo brtan ma dang*/ tshangs pa'i dbang dang lha dbang dang*// klu dbang mthu chen rnams dang ni// mi'am ci dang lha min dbang*// de bzhin nam mkha' lding dbang rnams// sde dang stobs dang gzhon par bcas// bcas te de dag lhags nas ni// nyin dang mtshan mo mi g.yel bar// de dag la ni srung bar byed// zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis gsungs pa ste// bskal ba bye ba spyod dka' bar// mdo 'di rab tu bshad par bya// gang dag mdo 'di nyan pa dang*// gang dag gzhan las thos byed dang*// gang dag rjes su yi rangs dang*// gang dag mchod pa byed pa yi/ de dag rnams la lha dang klu// mi dang mi'am ci dag dang*// lha min gnod sbyin du ma yis// bskal pa du mar mchod par 'gyur// srog chags bsod nams byed pa rnams// de dag bsod nams phung po ni// mtha' yas grangs kyang med pa dang*// bsam gyis mi khyab skye bar 'gyur// phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// de bzhin zab mo spyod pa yi/

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*// rab tu bzung bar 'gyur ba yin// gtsang ma'i gos rnams rab bgos la// dri zhim pa yi gos 'chang zhing*/ byams pa'i sems ni nyer bzhag nas// g.yel ba med par mchod par bya// rang gi sems ni dri med cing*// rgya che bar yang rab byed la// sems kyang shin tu dad byed cing*// mdo sde dam pa nyan par gyis// gang dag mdo 'di nyan pa ni// de dag mi nor legs par 'ong*// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// 'tsho ba bde bas 'tsho bar 'gyur// gang gi rna ba'i bu gar yang*// bshad pa 'di ni grags gyur pa// de dag dge rtsa sbyangs pa ste// sangs rgyas mang pos rab tu bsngags// phyi mar gyur pa'i dus nyid du// mi rnams bsod nams nyams pa dang*// cho ga 'di la brtson byas na// yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar// dgos 'dod thams cad ster bar byed// shin tu dben zhing nyams dga' bar// gzhi ma dkar gtsang steng du ni// dkon mchog mchod pa rgya cher bshams// yi dam chos skyong gtor ma dang*// phyogs skyong nor lha sde brgyad la// dkar mngar mchod pa rgya cher bshams// mda' dar phye mar gser skyems mchod// rin chen bum pa mar khus bkang*// rba smyug rin chen gser g.yu dang*// g.yang gi rin chen mar gyis bkang*// mar lug dung sha chang phud sogs/ phyag rgya sbags kyis byin brlabs te// byang phyogs gnod sbyin gter nang nas// rin chen sna tshogs mdzes par byas// sems bskyed yan lag tshangs byas nas// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan dran na// chos kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// chos kun rnams la mnga' mdzad pa// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas rnams// bkra shis skyid rtags gnas 'dir byon// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// thugs rje'i byin rlabs chen po yis// phywa dang g.yang du bskyab tu gsol// chos rnams gang dag me long 'dra// rnam rtog bral bas me long ltar// mi skye mi 'gag gzugs sku 'char// dri med 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du// yang dag thabs shes sku ru gsal// g.yang brtan mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la byon// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du blan/

byin rlabs phya dang g.yang du 'dus// dge 'dun byang chub phyir mi ldog /mi rtog rab dga' sa la bzhugs// gzhan don ma rig mun sel ba// bkra shis skyid rtags g.yang la byon// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// gal te 'di la bgegs yod na// dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs dang*// khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// lus kyang dum bu stong du 'jig /oṃ sā badzra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// yum chen shes rab pha rol phyin// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshesrog bskyab tu gsol// 'og min chos kyi gzhal yas nas// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dang*// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol/ bya rgod phung po'i ri bo nas// bcom ldan shākya thub pa dang*// nyan thos chen po mchog brgyad rnams// dar dkar g.yab cing g.yang du len// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// seng ge bsnol ba'i khri stengs su/ nyi zla padma'i gdan steng na/ bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad ni// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro/ phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams// zhal nas g.yab rab dam pa 'don// oṃ shrī badzra bai ro tsa na ratna siddhi hūṃ hrī ṭha/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bde ldan skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru/ 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// 'di nas shar phyogs zhing khams na// glang chen bsnol ba'i khri stengs su/ nyi zla padma'i gdan steng na// rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor bcas ni// sku mdog dkar gsal rgyan dang ldan/ phyag na gser gyi lhung bzed bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ badzra ratna hūm̐ hrī ṭhā/

dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bde ldan skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// 'di nas lho phyogs rol pa na// rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas// rta mchog bsnol ba'i khri stengs su// nyi zla padma'i gdan stengs na// bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan ni// sku mdog gser gyi lhun po 'dra// phyag na g.yang gi dung zhal bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ ā badzra ratna sarba bha wa hu hrī ṭha/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru/ 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// rma bya bsnol ba'i khri stengs su// nyi zla padma'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med// tshe la dbang ba'i lha dang bcas// sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar/ phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// oṃ ā badzra a mṛ ta padma saṃ bha wa hūm̐ hrī ṭhā/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// byang gi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// shang shang bsnol ba'i khri stengs su/ nyi zla padma'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan don yod grub pa ni// ljang khu ind+ra nī la'i mdog /'phrin las grub pa'i lha dang bcas// phyag na g.yu'i lhung bzed bsnams// rin chen g.yang gis gang ba bsnams// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// o sā a mo gha karma siddhi sarba dza hūm̐ hrī ṭha/ dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru/ 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// dbus kyi gtso la bzhugs pa ni// gtsug tor dkar mo lha mo che// sku mdog dkar mo gangs ri 'dra/ dbu stong spyan gyis kun tu gzigs/

phyag mtshan rnam grangs stong dang ldan// thugs rjes 'gro ba kun la snyoms// mi dang nor gyi bdag po ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren no// bkra shis skyid rtags gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// shar gyi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// rdo rje gtsug tor lha mo ste/ phyag na rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams// g.yon na g.yu yi dril bu gsil// bde ldan skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag tshe g.yang bskyab tu gsol// lho yi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// rin chen gtsug tor lha mo che/ phyag na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// gser gyi dril bu gsung snyan sgrogs// mi g.yang sdud pa'i bdag mo ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag mi g.yang bskyab tu gsol// nub kyi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// padma gtsug tor lha mo ste/ phyag na padma 'dab brgyad bsnams// g.yon na g.yang gi zhags pa 'dzin// phyugs g.yang sdud pa'i bdag po ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// yon bdag phyugs g.yang bskyab tu gsol/ byang gi phyogs na bzhugs pa ni// las kyi gtsug tor lha mo che/ phyag na rdo rje rgya gram bsnams// g.yon pa 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// lo g.yang sdud pa'i bdag mo ste// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la// bdag cag lo g.yang bskyab tu gsol// gra yi phyogs ni kun tu yong*// rigs kyi yuṃ dang gsang ba'i yum// dgos pa rnams ni ster ba dang*// lo tsā dang ni ma mā ki/ dkar mo sgrol ma la sogs rnams// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// dum bu bzhi la g.yang rten gsol// lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang*// lha rnams kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*// pha rol chos kyi dge slong mdzad// lha bran mang po sgra sgrog cing*// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// yid bzhin nor bu g.yang du btags// g.yas pas lha yi pho brang du// bkra shis g.yang rnams brtan pa yis// don grub lha mo 'phrin las chu// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// gnas 'dir bsrung ba'i las mdzod cig

/de ring yon bdag 'khor bcas la// mi yi tshe dang nor gyi gyi g.yang*// zas kyi bcud dang skom gyi bcud// rta phyugs srog chags kun gyi gyi g.yang*// mi rnams kun la bskyab tu gsol// khyed cag kun la bde legs shog /de dag sdig pa ma gyur cig /nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin// rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin// sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che// dgra bcom thams cad zag pa zad// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas// bdag cag rnams la bde legs shog /lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong bar shog /skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul// dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ chos skyong la bstod bskul drag po bya/ de nas nor lha rnams la g.yang blan pa ni phye mar dang*/ gser skyems kyis mchod de 'di skad do// hūṃ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed kyi bka' nyan gsung sdod ni// ci 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa// mthu chen stobs dang ldan pa po// gnod sbyin sum khri drug stong la// mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ phye mar mda' dar rin chen dang*/ bdud rtsi gser skyems sil snyan sogs// dkar mngar sman gyi mchod pa 'bul// nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ byang phyogs dkor mdzod pho brang nas/ nor lha'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin kun gyi gtso bo ste// sku la bse khrab 'bar ba gsol// phyag na ba dan rtse brgyad 'phyar// g.yon pa rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// gser gyi mchod rten ser po las// dgos 'dod rin chen char ltar 'bab// chibs su seng ge 'gying pa chibs// nor lha bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor// kun kyang rin chen rgyan cha can// la la rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir byon la/

rin chen dngos grub bdag la stsol// oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya ratna siddhi sa ma ya hūṃ hrī ṭha// bcom ldan lha mo nor rgyun ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya yis// 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'gro ba sdud/ g.yon pa'i phyag gi thugs ka ru/ rin chen 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin// dgos 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa// dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ltar// dbul ba sel zhing nyon mongs 'joms// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// rta glang rin chen gos dang 'bru// khrus kyi rdzing bu la sogs pa// rin chen dngos grub bdag la stsol// oṃ gha taṃ dzambha sems rā ga ni ma ka ra badzra rakṣa ting ti sarba dza hu hrī ṭha/ yid bzhin nor bu rin chen gter mdzod nas// nor lha'i rgyal po arya dzambha la// btso ma gser mdog gzi brjid ldan// rin chen rgyan ldan phan sems can/ phyag g.yas nor bu ster mdzad pa/ phyag g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// mi nor zas gos dngos grub stsol// oṃ dzambha dza land+ra ya ratna siddhi dza hūṃ hrī ṭhā// gnod sbyin rgyal po rin chen sbyin// rin chen gter mdzod bdag po ste// nor bu rin chen char ltar 'bebs// bdag la nor gyi dngos grub stsol// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gyis// 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod dang*// bla na med pa chen po'i nor// ci 'dod phun sum tshogs pa yi// dngos grub chen po bdag la stsol// oṃ hri a pa ra tsi ti bdag la siddhi dza hūṃ// gnod sbyin rgyal po gter bdag po// bzhugs pa ri rab rtse la bzhugs// thugs ni 'dzam gling kun la khyab// sku mdog dmar ser gzi brjid la// nor rgyun ma yi yum dang bcas// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'byung po mnan// rin chen bzang po khyod la bstod// oṃ a phu yu ṇi sha yā dha ra dha ra dhi ri dhi ri swā hā// nor lha'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// sku mdog ma nges cir yang ston/

phyag mtshan mdung dang ba dan bsnams// mchod rten rin chen ne'u le 'dzin// ri rab gling bzhi mi yi bcud// rnam rgyal khang bzang nor gyis 'gengs// yid bzhin nor gyi g.yang 'bebs pa// re ba skong zhing nor rnams sbyin// zhal nas g.yang rab dam pa 'don// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ya ma hā ga ra dzā ya/ tadya thā/ su mu su mu/ tsan dha tsan dha/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ sandha pa ye/ ad ma nam nyid tan/ an da ra dhu ra swā hā/ na mo bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā/ dhā na dha ye swā hā/ na mo ratna ba ri swā hā/ mi nor zas gsum thams cad dhi sha ma na ye he be rna ratna siddhi swā hā// rin chen rgyal ba rgyas shing 'phel// sgyu ma'i bang mdzod nam mkha' mnyam// kar sha pa ṇi brgya stong phrag /nyin re bzhin du gnang bar mdzod// mi yi 'khor lo sgyur ba de// mi rnams kun la mnga' brnyes pa// skye bo mang po 'phel zhing rgyas// dkon mchog g.yon bdag mdzad pa yi// 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po khyod// mi rnams bde dang skyid pa'i don// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// rin chen sna bdun bdag la stsol// rta lha ārya re manta// rngog chags kun la dbang bsgyur zhing*// dgra lha'i mchog ste nyi ma'i sras// khyod ni dgra lha'i mched yin te// chibs su sngon po sgal nag chibs// bzhengs na stag gnyis sngon la 'gro// seng chen gnyis ni phyi nas 'brang*// khyung chen gnyis ni klad la lding*// phrag par lcags kyi bya khra 'phur// dpal 'bar lam lha tshe bsrung zhing*// lam dang g.yul gyi dgra las rgyal// nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel ba yi/ nor gyi dngos grub bstsal ba'i phyir// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la byon// 'bru rnams 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ārya re manta bho ra siddhi ratna siddhi hūṃ hrī ṭhā/

phyugs lha kun gyi rgyal po ni// glang chen sa la rab brtan te// khyu mchog kun la mnga' mdzad pa/ phyag na g.yang gi zhags pa bsnams// be'u rnam rgyal 'khor dang bcas// phyugs rnams 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'du// phyugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// o a ba sha ratna siddhi pha la hūm̐ hrī ṭhā// lha rgyal ārya tsa muṇṭi/ nor bsrung parna sha wa ri// yo byad gyen du bsrung ba'i lha// lha dang klu dang lha ma yin// klu rgyal char 'bebs lo tog srung*// klu rgyal 'bru bcud spel mdzad pa// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// oṃ a na siddhi hūṃ hrī thā// nor lha'i 'phrin las bskul ba ni// hūṃ shar gyi phyogs nas g.yang sdud pa// ma hā de ba yab sras bzhi// khro bo dkar gsal brjid pa la/ phyag na dngul gyi lcags kyu bsnams// mi g.yang thams cad 'gugs par byed// g.yon na g.yu yi dril bu gsil/ bar chad thams cad sel bar mdzad// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// mi yi tshe g.yang brtan par gsol// lho yi phyogs nas g.yang sdud pa// ma hā de ba sras dang bcas// khro bo ser po mi bzad pa/ phyag na gser gyi phreng ba bsnams// gser dngul rin chen dbang du sdud// g.yon na g.yu yi dril bu 'dzin// gnod byed thams cad skrag par byed// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun/ bkra shis skyid pa'i gnas 'di ru// rin chen sna bdun rgyas par mdzod// nub kyi phyogs nas g.yang sdud pa// ma hā de ba lcam dral la// khro bo dmar po mi bzad pa/ phyag na g.yang gi zhags pa bsnams// phyugs g.yang thams cad 'gugs par byed// g.yon na gser gyi dril bu 'dzin// tshe g.yang thams cad 'gugs par byed// dar dkar g.yab cing spyan 'dren na/

'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun// bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang la 'dus// rkang bzhi nor gyi dngos grub stsol// byang gi phyogs nas g.yang sdud pa// ma hā de ba yab yum gnyis// khro bo sngo skya brjid
